result.brief: 提出 TokJSNC，将视频编码为可变长离散 token 流并利用视频 token 时空相关性实现抗丢包传输，为生成式视频 tokenizer 的表征复用提供新框架。
result.reason: Proposes tokenized joint source-network coding using learned video tokenizers' spatiotemporal token correlations for loss-resilient streaming, a concrete contribution to video token/representation design.
